# Stargate V2 send test vectors

Calls to `send` on the Stargate V2 USDC pool on Ethereum.

```solidity
struct SendParam {
    uint32 dstEid;
    bytes32 to;
    uint256 amountLD;
    uint256 minAmountLD;
    bytes extraOptions;
    bytes composeMsg;
    bytes oftCmd;
}

struct MessagingFee {
    uint256 nativeFee;
    uint256 lzTokenFee;
}

function send(SendParam calldata _sendParam, MessagingFee calldata _fee, address _refundAddress) external payable;
```

Descriptor: [`example-stargate-v2-send.json`](./example-stargate-v2-send.json)

All vectors are sent by `0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111` to `0xc026395860Db2d07ee33e05fE50ed7bD583189C7` on Ethereum.

## Taxi to Arbitrum with default options

Arguments:

```
value: 0.0004 ETH
sendParam:
  dstEid: 30110
  to: 0x0000000000000000000000001111111111111111111111111111111111111111
  amountLD: 1000000000
  minAmountLD: 999500000
  extraOptions: 0x
  composeMsg: 0x
  oftCmd: 0x
fee:
  nativeFee: 400000000000000
  lzTokenFee: 0
refundAddress: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Intent: Bridge USDC
Amount: 1000 USDC
Minimum received: 999.5 USDC
Destination: Arbitrum
Recipient: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Delivery: Immediate (taxi)
Delivery options: Default
Destination call: None
Messaging fee: 0.0004 ETH
Fee refund to: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

## Taxi to Base with destination gas and a native drop

Arguments:

```
value: 0.0009 ETH
sendParam:
  dstEid: 30184
  to: 0x000000000000000000000000a11cea11cea11cea11cea11cea11cea11cea11ce
  amountLD: 2500000000
  minAmountLD: 2498000000
  extraOptions: abi.encodePacked(...)
    optionsType: 3
    [0]: abi.encodePacked(...)
      workerId: 0x01
      size: 33
      optionType: 0x01
      option: abi.encodePacked(...)
        gas: 200000
        value: 0
    [1]: abi.encodePacked(...)
      workerId: 0x01
      size: 49
      optionType: 0x02
      option: abi.encodePacked(...)
        amount: 10000000000000000
        receiver: 0x000000000000000000000000a11cea11cea11cea11cea11cea11cea11cea11ce
  composeMsg: 0x
  oftCmd: 0x
fee:
  nativeFee: 900000000000000
  lzTokenFee: 0
refundAddress: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Intent: Bridge USDC
Amount: 2500 USDC
Minimum received: 2498 USDC
Destination: Base
Recipient: 0xA11cea11CEA11CEA11cEa11CeA11ceA11CEA11Ce
Delivery: Immediate (taxi)
Destination gas: 200000
Value on arrival (wei): 0
Native drop (wei): 10000000000000000
Native drop recipient: 0x000000000000000000000000a11cea11cea11cea11cea11cea11cea11cea11ce
Destination call: None
Messaging fee: 0.0009 ETH
Fee refund to: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

## Bus to Base with a native drop

A non-empty `oftCmd` selects the bus, where `extraOptions` is only checked for being empty.

Arguments:

```
value: 0.0002 ETH
sendParam:
  dstEid: 30184
  to: 0x0000000000000000000000001111111111111111111111111111111111111111
  amountLD: 500000000
  minAmountLD: 499500000
  extraOptions: abi.encodePacked(...)
    optionsType: 3
    [0]: abi.encodePacked(...)
      workerId: 0x01
      size: 49
      optionType: 0x02
      option: abi.encodePacked(...)
        amount: 1000000000000000
        receiver: 0x0000000000000000000000001111111111111111111111111111111111111111
  composeMsg: 0x
  oftCmd: 0x01
fee:
  nativeFee: 200000000000000
  lzTokenFee: 0
refundAddress: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Intent: Bridge USDC
Amount: 500 USDC
Minimum received: 499.5 USDC
Destination: Base
Recipient: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Delivery: Batched (bus)
Delivery options: Native drop on arrival, amount set by the bus
Destination call: None
Messaging fee: 0.0002 ETH
Fee refund to: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

## Taxi to Solana with a compose message

A non-EVM recipient is shown as raw bytes.

Arguments:

```
value: 0.0006 ETH
sendParam:
  dstEid: 30168
  to: 0x0b6c3f5a5f4e2d1c0b0a99887766554433221100ffeeddccbbaa998877665544
  amountLD: 100000000
  minAmountLD: 99500000
  extraOptions: abi.encodePacked(...)
    optionsType: 3
    [0]: abi.encodePacked(...)
      workerId: 0x01
      size: 17
      optionType: 0x01
      option: abi.encodePacked(...)
        gas: 300000
  composeMsg: abi.encode(...)
    address: 0xA11cea11CEA11CEA11cEa11CeA11ceA11CEA11Ce
    uint256: 7
  oftCmd: 0x
fee:
  nativeFee: 600000000000000
  lzTokenFee: 0
refundAddress: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Intent: Bridge USDC
Amount: 100 USDC
Minimum received: 99.5 USDC
Destination: Solana
Recipient: 0x0b6c3f5a5f4e2d1c0b0a99887766554433221100ffeeddccbbaa998877665544
Delivery: Immediate (taxi)
Destination gas: 300000
Destination call: Calls a contract on the destination chain
Messaging fee: 0.0006 ETH
Fee refund to: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```
